source: shout-chords-1.mp4 — phone screen recording of a Facebook Live (Steven S Golden Jr. stream, "Devin Watkins closing the Inspirational speake..."). Organist likely Montrell James per a stream comment; NOT Lawrence's own playing. Preacher talking over the PA throughout.
tempoNote: 136 BPM from Sanctum engine and librosa on the de-vocalled mix; the full mix beat-tracks at 117.5 because of speech — 136 is the trusted value.

dropouts.note: digital silence in the recording (stream dropout) — any chord shown here is an artefact

method: Primary: librosa 0.11 CQT chroma on a Demucs (htdemucs) de-vocalled mix (other+bass stems), beat-synchronous, template match over 16 qualities x 12 roots, Viterbi smoothing; bass from pYIN on the bass stem. Cross-check: Sanctum src/chords offline detector (analyseChords, fft 4096, hop 2048, stay 0.75/0.4). Frames reviewed visually: hands/keys not readable, no on-screen chord names.
confidenceScale: 0–1 template fit, halved in dropouts; flag high>=0.6, med 0.35–0.6, low <0.35 or <2 beats
